Package org.thewhitemage13.service

Class OrderService

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.service.OrderService
All Implemented Interfaces:
OrderServiceInterface
@Transactional @Service public class OrderService extends Object implements OrderServiceInterface
Service class for managing orders in the application.

This class provides methods for creating, updating, and retrieving orders. It integrates with external services for inventory and user validation, processes Kafka events, and manages order data in the database.

Features:

  • Create new orders with validation for products and users.
  • Update order status and notify via Kafka messaging.
  • Retrieve orders with caching support for optimized performance.

  • Method Details

    • createOrder

      public void createOrder(CreateOrderDTO createOrderDTO)
      Creates a new order.

      Validates product availability, retrieves pricing and user information, and calculates the total cost. Saves the order in the database and publishes an event to the Kafka topic.

      Specified by:
      createOrder in interface OrderServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      createOrderDTO - the DTO containing order creation details
      Throws:
      org.thewhitemage13.exception.ProductNotFoundException - if the product is not available
      org.thewhitemage13.exception.UserNotFoundException - if the user is not found

    • updateOrderStatus

      @CacheEvict(cacheNames="orders", key="#orderId") public void updateOrderStatus(Long orderId, String status) throws OrderNotFoundException
      Updates the status of an existing order.

      Retrieves the order by its ID, updates its status, saves the changes, and publishes an event to Kafka. Evicts the cached data for the specified order.

      Specified by:
      updateOrderStatus in interface OrderServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      orderId - the ID of the order to be updated
      status - the new status of the order
      Throws:
      OrderNotFoundException - if the order is not found
